periods.name: 恰特治安警察与陆军误攻
periods.summary: Raru's report leads corrupt police/army to attack the adult-form Carbuncle by mistake with mortars, tank, drones, remote bombs, a buried bomb and finally a Refleks missile. Watson saves Carbuncle by surgery while the team defends the shrine.
periods.outcome: Carbuncle survives; police/army stop after learning the truth; Kinji diverts the missile into the magic array.
